title: Fencing: the greats overview

definition: The greatest Fencing players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
description: The pantheon of Fencing is argued in every bar and barbershop, but the names in this database appear on every serious list: champions who won the biggest prizes, record-setters whose numbers still stand, and pioneers who changed how Fencing is played.
